 MODEL NOTES

Inspired by my own car.

This project is inspired by my own car: a 2024 BMW X5 40i M-Sport (G05 LCI).

This is an independent educational atlas of its drivetrain. The exterior adapts BMW’s openly licensed G05 model with reconstructed LCI M Sport details. The drivetrain is illustrated from component references. This is an educational model, not factory LCI CAD or a service reference. The image sources and their applicability are listed under Parts & sources.

The rear-biased system varies front/rear power distribution with an electronically controlled multi-plate clutch in the transfer case. Clutch motion and scenarios explain this principle; they do not reproduce BMW software, exact clutch pressure, torque percentages or disengagement thresholds.

The transmission includes the 48V mild-hybrid motor. It is represented as an integrated assembly here. Brake-based traction interventions are described, rather than simulated.

BMW X5 / X6 LCI technical press kit ↗

COMPONENT INVENTORY

From reference to 3D.

Inspired by my own 2024 BMW X5 40i M-Sport, this atlas uses visual references for each assembly. Supplier photographs establish shape, not exact fitment to a particular VIN. Older designs and other variants are identified as generic references.
